title: Massachusetts's 9th Congressional District Election, 2026
description: The 2026 election for Massachusetts's 9th Congressional District will determine who represents the South Shore, South Coast, Cape Cod, Martha's Vineyard, and Nantucket in the U.S. House of Representatives. Incumbent Democrat Bill Keating, first elected in 2010, faces a primary challenge from community organizer Craig Swallow, while Republican Tyler MacAllister is running on the Republican side. The district is rated "Solid D" by the Cook Political Report and is considered the least liberal Democratic-held district in Massachusetts, giving the general election somewhat more competitive dynamics than other seats in the state. Key issues include affordability, infrastructure (particularly the Bourne and Sagamore Bridges), coastal resiliency, and national security.
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found for this race as of mid-2026. The Cook Political Report rates the district as Solid Democratic.

candidates.name: Bill Keating
candidates.summary: Bill Keating is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Massachusetts's 9th Congressional District, first elected in 2010. He serves on the House Foreign Affairs and Armed Services Committees, chairs the Europe, Eurasia, Energy and Environment Subcommittee, and has focused on national security, homeland security, coastal issues, and combating the opioid epidemic. Prior to Congress, Keating served in the Massachusetts House and Senate and was Norfolk County District Attorney.

candidates.name: Craig Swallow
candidates.summary: Craig Swallow is a community organizer and former educator running as a Democratic primary challenger against incumbent Bill Keating. Born and raised in New Bedford, he is co-leader of Indivisible 'Do Something' South Coast New England, a grassroots progressive group. Swallow's campaign focuses on affordability, accountability, healthcare, housing, and climate justice, arguing that longtime incumbents have become disconnected from working-class constituents.

candidates.name: R. Tyler MacAllister
candidates.summary: Tyler MacAllister is the Republican candidate running for Massachusetts's 9th Congressional District. A commercial fisherman, charter boat captain, and cancer survivor from Mattapoisett, he has served 13 years on the Mattapoisett Select Board and has appeared on the Discovery Channel show 'Harpoon Hunters.' MacAllister's campaign focuses on lowering the cost of living, securing the border, reducing healthcare costs, achieving energy independence, replacing the Bourne and Sagamore Bridges, and bringing non-career-politician leadership to Washington.

forecast.rationale: No public polling exists for this race as of mid-2026, so the forecast relies on structural factors. The Cook Political Report rates the district as Solid Democratic. Incumbent Bill Keating has held the seat since 2010 and serves on key committees (Foreign Affairs, Armed Services). While this is considered the least liberal Democratic-held district in Massachusetts, the Democratic lean remains substantial. The Democratic primary challenge from Craig Swallow introduces some nomination uncertainty but does not materially affect the general-election outlook. Republican Tyler MacAllister is running but faces long odds in a heavily Democratic district. Without polling, the safe D rating reflects institutional and historical advantages but carries medium confidence due to the absence of direct voter-intent data.
